dimensions.note: issues.ts and labels.ts carry no secret; bodies and labels are public text; the token stays in api.ts, which redacts it from any response.
One line per issue or label with its action; no body is logged.

Forgejo errors surface through call() with its message; an unknown label name is refused before any issue is filed and names every missing label; a create answered without an id is an error. A 200 that is not a list yields an empty list, so an odd answer could lead to a duplicate issue rather than a failure; accepted, covered by a test.

27 new tests over fake callers, 92 in all: issue create and exact-title match across states, batch, refusals before any call, second-page match, label resolution; issue_labels_ensure additive, unchanged, exact replace, unknown label refused before the issue is touched; label create, patch, prune, pagination, org versus user owner.
Title and name are the identities; a rerun reports unchanged and sends nothing. Labels are patched in place, keeping their id and the issues they are on.

Paths and bodies follow Forgejo swagger: repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues with type=issues and q; issues/{index}/labels GET, POST (add) and PUT (replace) with label ids; orgs/{org}/labels and repos/{owner}/{repo}/labels; color sent with #, compared without.

Pages of 50 followed to at most 20, so a repository past 1000 issues of one search or 1000 labels is not fully read; a match beyond that could lead to a duplicate issue. Accepted for the forge's size.
README table and two sections added; manifest lists both modules and bumps the version; every export carries JSDoc.
zod schemas with bounds: titles 1 to 255, label names 1 to 50, descriptions 200, colors six hex digits, at most 20 issues and 100 labels per call; duplicate titles or names refused by refine.
issue and label resources are infinite with garbageCollection 20, as topics are.

Labels: create, update, list, delete only with prune. Issues: create, list, and the labels of an existing issue or pull request by number; closing and editing are deliberately absent, since the title is the identity and a closed issue is reported, never reopened.
The shared checks of checks.ts (apiUrl shape, token accepted) apply to the type; nothing new to check.
<owner>:<repo>:issue:<number>, <owner>:<repo>:issue:<number>:labels and <owner>:<repo or org>:label:<name>, with slashes and whitespace folded to colons; distinct specs, no collision.
writeResource only; no reads of other models' data.
2026.10.05.1 to .2 adds one method and one resource type; nothing existing changes shape.
